==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 846
|text = The cryptic reveals where to dig:<br><br>Dig where only the skilled, the wealthy, or the brave can choose not to visit again.

==Transportation==
*[[Lumbridge Teleport]] or [[Lumbridge Home Teleport]].
*[[Achievement diary cape]] teleport to [[Mikasi]].
*[[Ring of the elements]] to the [[Water Altar]] and run north-east.
*[[Amulet of glory]] teleport to [[Al Kharid]] or [[Draynor Village]].
